description: PATCH ordinary study metadata only. Use customize_study—not this tool—for the research plan, audience targeting, screener questions, concept links, or concept images. Only supplied fields change. Active panel studies must be paused or stopped first. Call get_study first.

interview_format.description: Interview mode. Defaults to voice when omitted.

organization_id.description: Platform admins only: select an organization for this operation. Required when changing another organization’s study or using its wallet.

recruiting_method.description: Required explicit human choice. Ask the user to choose panel, BYOP, or synthetic respondents before calling create_study; do not guess or silently default it.

voice.description: Interviewer configuration for every format, including chat. Defaults to male when omitted.

name: update_study

result.description: The updated study. Call get_study for full state.
